versions.changelog: 1. Reverted: Security section merged back into SKILL.md; removed references/ directory. 回退：安全章节合并回 SKILL.md，移除 references/ 目录。 2. Kept: Execution rules with confirmation and allowlist guidance. 保留：执行规则中的确认机制和 allowlist 建议。
1. Moved: Security section to references/security.md for cleaner SKILL.md structure. 移动：安全章节移至 references/security.md，保持 SKILL.md 精简。
1. Added: App/action allowlist guidance and sensitive-app avoidance. 新增：操作 allowlist 建议和敏感 app 规避。 2. Added: Dependency pinning recommendations for Open-AutoGLM and ADBKeyboard. 新增：外部依赖版本锁定建议。

1. Added: Security & Privacy section with data disclosure, external dependency notice, and cleanup guide. 新增：安全与隐私章节，包含数据披露、外部依赖说明和使用后清理建议。 2. Changed: Execution rules now require user confirmation for write/send operations. 变更：执行规则改为写入/发送操作必须用户确认。
Initial release. 初始发布：基于 AutoGLM-Phone 的手机智能操控技能，支持自然语言控制安卓手机。
